target: scripts/sol_common.py + scripts/ask_sol.py + scripts/cross_review.py - Sol tooling: shared key/chat helpers, general ask tool, refactor cross_review to use them.

Hardening from running cross_review on the new code: (1) empty API content should surface not print blank success, (2) ask_sol must mark file/stdin as untrusted data (prompt injection), (3) load_api_key must skip empty OPENAI_API_KEY values and fall through. Key resolution now also searches .env.local and frontend-nextjs/.env.local.
